blocks.text: Digital analytics platform for data-driven product decisions

Amplitude provides enterprise-grade product analytics for teams that have outgrown simpler tools. Its strength is in the depth of behavioral analysis - cohort comparison, impact analysis, pathfinder, and predictive analytics that help product teams make data-driven decisions at scale.

The experimentation platform is fully integrated with analytics, meaning you can test hypotheses and measure results in the same tool. Launch A/B tests, measure impact on key metrics, and iterate - all with statistical rigor built into the platform.

For companies practicing product-led growth, Amplitude's CDP (Customer Data Platform) capabilities unify user data from multiple sources into a single behavioral profile. This unified view powers both analytics and personalization, ensuring consistent user experiences across touchpoints.
Event tracking, funnels, retention, and user journey analysis
Integrated A/B testing with statistical significance calculations
Unified customer profiles from multiple data sources
Compare user segments to identify patterns and opportunities
AI-powered predictions for churn, conversion, and lifetime value
Schema enforcement, taxonomy management, and data quality tools

When product analytics needs outgrow Mixpanel or PostHog - complex cohort analysis, cross-platform tracking, enterprise governance - Amplitude provides the depth and scale that data-driven product organizations need.
Our team can integrate Amplitude into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
